summary.text: Sydney Batch is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 17 since January 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 37, from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Batch earned a bachelor's degree in English, a master's degree in social work and a J.D., all from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a social worker, as an attorney, and as co-owner of a law firm.
According to Ballotpedia, Gov. Roy Cooper appointed Batch to the Senate on January 11, 2021, to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Sam Searcy, a fellow Democrat.
For the 2025-2026 session, it lists her as a member of the Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Appropriations/Base Budget, Commerce and Insurance, Finance, and Judiciary committees.
